    Interface CliOptions

    ExifTool-style command-line parsing.

    parseCliArgs consumes tokens already normalized by normalizeArgs (ExifTool single-dash long forms mapped onto --long). Unknown dash-tokens fall through as operands so -TAG=VALUE write assignments reach runAction untouched, mirroring the real ExifTool CLI.
